#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const long long INF = 1LL << 60;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    long long cap, cost;
    Edge(int t, int r, long long c, long long co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(co) {}
};

struct Graph {
    int V;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    Graph(int V) : V(V), adj(V) {}
    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, long long cost, long long cap) {
        adj[from].push_back(Edge(to, adj[to].size(), cap, cost));
        adj[to].push_back(Edge(from, adj[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    Graph& g;
    int s, t;
    vector<long long> phi, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;

    MinCostFlow(Graph& g, int s, int t, bool hasNegative) 
        : g(g), s(s), t(t), phi(g.V, 0), dist(g.V), prevv(g.V), preve(g.V), visited(g.V, -1), visitIndex(0) {
        if (hasNegative) {
            fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), INF);
            phi[s] = 0;
            vector<bool> inQueue(g.V, false);
            queue<int> q;
            q.push(s);
            inQueue[s] = true;
            int steps = 0;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                int v = q.front(); q.pop();
                inQueue[v] = false;
                for (const auto& e : g.adj[v]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        int u = e.to;
                        long long nd = phi[v] + e.cost;
                        if (phi[u] > nd) {
                            phi[u] = nd;
                            if (!inQueue[u]) {
                                q.push(u);
                                inQueue[u] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (++steps > 2 * g.V * g.V) throw runtime_error("Negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(INF);
    }

    pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow(long long maxf) {
        long long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            visitIndex++;
            for (int i = 0; i < g.V; i++) {
                int v = -1;
                long long best = INF;
                for (int j = 0; j < g.V; j++) {
                    if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dist[j] < best) {
                        best = dist[j];
                        v = j;
                    }
                }
                if (v == -1) break;
                visited[v] = visitIndex;
                for (size_t ei = 0; ei < g.adj[v].size(); ei++) {
                    const Edge& e = g.adj[v][ei];
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        int u = e.to;
                        if (visited[u] != visitIndex) {
                            long long nd = best + e.cost + phi[v] - phi[u];
                            if (dist[u] > nd) {
                                dist[u] = nd;
                                prevv[u] = v;
                                preve[u] = ei;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < g.V; v++) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) phi[v] += dist[v];
            }
            long long add = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                add = min(add, g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += add;
            cost += add * phi[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge& e = g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= add;
                g.adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += add;
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    
    int pairCount = (n + 1) / 2;
    int V = n + 26 + 2;
    int source = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;
    Graph g(V);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
            int left = j;
            int right = n - 1 - j;
            long long w = 0;
            if (s[left] == s[right]) {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) {
                    w = -max(a[left], a[right]);
                }
            } else {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[left];
                if (s[right] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[right];
            }
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
        }
    }
    
    for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(j, sink, 0, 2);
    }
    
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, sink, true);
    auto result = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -result.first << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
